# Pinned external evidence

These files are verbatim snapshots from Jeromie Beasley's companion repositories.
Exact repository, commit, original path, blob SHA and recorded CI run are in
`../external_sources.json`. Each repository's license is retained in its directory.
The connection-energy files may be used under their retained MIT license.

These snapshots are not included in this repository's Lake roots and are not fresh
external-project builds. They make the names and assumptions behind the ledger
inspectable at a fixed revision. Fifteen companion repositories have a successful
GitHub Actions run on the captured head. Connection energy instead has a committed
verification report, whose source SHA-256 entries are checked against the retained
SelfCommutator and Holonomy files by the coverage validator.
